notes.title: Update V8.2.1
notes.content:
Good afternoon, dear students of LOCO music!

In this update, we have transferred the application to a new compiler, and the question immediately arises, what does this mean for you?

The new compiler will fix the error that occurred at launch of the application earlier. Some users encountered a startup problem, during which the initial loading screen stopped and the application did not respond to the commands of the user, and sometimes the task manager, as a result of which the PC had to restart.

The issue has now been fixed and we are moving forward with confidence to the next update.

The next update will be big!


In the upcoming update, we will release our first video tutorials. At the beginning, they will be available only in Russian, with the following update where all of the lessons will be translated into other languages available in the application. 

------------

Best wishes,

lonch.me team

------------

You can contact us by e-mail:

lonchdev@gmail.com

notes.title: Now LOCO music supports MIDI keyboard
notes.content:
Hello dear Loco Music students!

Lonch.me team congratulates everyone congratulates everyone on the transition to the new version of the application v8.1.1


In our first major update, we added new features that were not available before, we really hope that these innovations will make your learning process more convenient and more productive.

Now we will list all of the changes and innovations that have occurred since the release date:

[h3] Version v8.1.1 (New) [/h3] 
· In the current update, we have added support for MIDI keyboard. Now every user, having a synthesizer, digital piano, or any other keyboard instrument that can be connected to a computer, can make the learning process truly fun and most useful, because now you will practice not only by reading notes, but also their practical performance on the instrument itself.
· Restart button has been added
· Added functionality for the game time control buttons (pause, play, stop).
· Now, when you click on the "return to the menu" button after passing the level, you will be transferred to the course menu.
· Replaced the sounds of notes.
· We also made a bunch of minor changes.

As of 30.06.2021:
[*]Added support for MIDI keyboard
[*]Minor bugs fixed

[h3] Version v7.7.2 (Old) [/h3] 

In this update, 2 new courses "Bass Clef" and "Alteration Signs" were added. 
As of 21.05.2021: 
[*] There are 30+ more exercises in LOCO music. 
[*] It became possible to study the placement of notes on the stave in the Bass Clef. 
[*] It became possible to study the signs of alteration and the principle of their action. 
[/list] 

[h3] Version v7.6.7 (Old) [/h3] 

As of 14.05.2021:
 • Window mode has been added. 
• The ability to select the designation of notes on the keys was added, at the moment there are 3 options available: CDEFGAH, CDEFGAB and without designation (empty). 
• The transition to the "Exercises" page from the settings was added when you click on the "gear" again • A transition to the "Exercises" page has been added by clicking on the LOCO music logo in the upper left corner of the screen. 
• Now, when minimizing the application, music and other sounds are completely turned off. 
• Now, after successfully completing the exercise, instead of the "Repeat" button, there is a "Next" button when you click on which you will be taken to the course menu in which the completed exercise was located. 
• All dropdown menus can now be closed by clicking on outside of them. 
• Fixed a bug where background music played during exercise. 
• Fixed a bug that triggered repeated playback of the sound of loading user statistics.

 ------------ 

Kind regards, 

lonch.me Team 

------------ 

You can contact us by email: lonchdev@gmail.com

notes.title: Update announcement v 8.1.1
notes.content:
Hello dear Loco Music students!

We are very excited to announce that in 15 days (30th of June) Loco music will have MIDI keyboard support available!

And this means that:
[olist]
[*] You will be able to start actively practicing your skills on keyboard instruments.
[*] Improve your coordination skills by sight-reading and playing the instrument in parallel.
[*] Be able to train each hand playing in “its own key”.
[/olist]
With time we will add ability to play parts with two hands, for owners of MIDI keyboard.

You can leave your questions in the comments below, and we will happily answer all of them!

Thank you for being with us!

------------

Kind regards,

Lonch.me Team

------------

You can contact us using our email: lonchdev@gmail.com

notes.title: Update V7.6.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In today's update, we have fixed bugs, added new features and put into operation some interface elements.

Here’s a complete list of all the updates:

· Window Mode Added
· Added the ability to select the designation of notes on the keys, currently the following 3 options are available: CDEFGAH, CDEFGAB and no designation (empty).
· Added transition to the "Exercises" page from the settings when you click on the "gear" again
· Added transition to the "Exercises" page when you click on the LOCO music logo on the upper left corner of the screen.
· Now, when minimizing the game, music and other sounds are completely turned off.
· Now, after successfully completing the exercise, instead of the "Repeat" button, there is a "Next" button which takes you to the course menu where this exercise was located.
· Now all drop-down menus can be closed by clicking outside of them.
· Fixed a bug where background music played during exercise.
· Fixed a bug that triggered repeated playback of the sound of loading user statistics. 

In the next 7 days, we will release an update in which we will add exercises for 2 new courses to LOCO
music, which is more than 30 exercises extra!

We will keep you updated!

------------

Best wishes,

lonch.me team

------------

You can contact us using on: lonchdev@gmail.com

notes.title: Early Access
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to LOCO music.

From now on you can purchase LOCO music on steam and start learning and making music!

Please note that the application is in early access and at the moment we are actively working on new exercises, functions and preparing a detailed curriculum for video tutorials, please bear with us, we are working hard to introduce exciting in-game content for you as soon as possible.

We plan to release an updates every two weeks until the release date [i](sometimes even more often)[/i], now we are working on:

[list]
[*] Preparing a detailed curriculum for video tutorials.
[*] Support functions for MIDI keyboards and electronic drums.
[*] Preparing new exercises for the remaining courses.
[*] Development of a convenient sheet music editor so that you can create your own exercises and share them with your friends.
[*] Development of the leaderboard.
[*] Connecting saved progress to Steam cloud in order for you progress to be protected and stored remotely. 
[/list]
There is still a lot of work, but we are very glad and thankful that you are with us!

------------

Kind regards 

Lonch.me Team 

------------

You can contact us using the following email: lonchdev@gmail.com
